2008-09 Big East regular season championship | bowl_games = | bowl_list = | tournaments = NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament | tournament_list = [[2007 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament]] }} '''Earl Clark''' (born January 17, 1988) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player who formerly played for the [[University of Louisville]] [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|men's basketball team]]. Clark grew up in [[Plainfield, New Jersey]] and attended [[Rahway High School]] in [[Rahway, New Jersey]]. There, he scored 1,245 career points. As a senior, he averaged 25.2 points, 13.2 rebounds and five assists per game.[http://uoflsports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/clark_earl00.html Earl Clark], [[CSTV]]. Accessed January 2, 2008. As a freshman along with [[Derrick Caracter]], [[Edgar Sosa (basketball)|Edgar Sosa]], and [[Jerry Smith (basketball)|Jerry Smith]], the young group struggled early in the 2006-07 season. The team went on to win 8 out of its last 10 games, earning a bid to the [[2007 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA Tournament]]. In the first game of the 2007 NCAA Tournament, he scored 12 points, four rebounds and four steals against [[Stanford]]. Clark decided not to put his name in the 2008 NBA Draft and return to the University of Louisville. Early in his Junior season, Clark announced that he would forgo his senior season to enter the [[2009 NBA Draft]], and is a potential first round pick.{{cite web | url=http://www.nbadraftdepot.com/2009/01/2009-nba-mock-draft.html| title=Draft Depot - 2009 NBA Mock Draft | publisher = | accessdate=2009-05-28}} On [[April 4]] [[2009]], [[sports agent|agent]] Dan Fegan told [[ESPN]] that he had signed Clark as a client shortly after the end of Louisville's [[2008–09 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|2008–09 season]], which under NCAA rules ends Clark's college eligibility.{{cite web|url= http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2009/columns/story?columnist=ford_chad&page=InOut |title=Who's in, who's out of 2009 draft? |first=Chad |last=Ford |publisher=''[[ESPN.com]]'' |date=2009-04-01 |accessdate=2009-04-01}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://uoflsports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/clark_earl00.html Player bio] at the University of Louisville {{Louisville Cardinals current roster}} {{Persondata |NAME= Clark, Earl |ALTERNATIVE NAMES= |SHORT DESCRIPTION= |DATE OF BIRTH= 1988-1-17 |PLACE OF BIRTH= [[Plainfield, New Jersey]] |DATE OF DEATH= |PLACE OF DEATH= }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Clark, Earl}} [[Category:Louisville Cardinals men's basketball players]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:1988 births]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Rahway High School alumni]] [[Category:People from Plainfield, New Jersey]] [[Category:Basketball players from New Jersey]] {{1980s-US-basketball-bio-stub}}
